page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.6xlarge is a storage-focused virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with 24 dedicated physical cores using the Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 96.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

A defining characteristic of this instance is its massive local storage capacity, offering 70,866 GB of local HDD storage. This high-density magnetic storage configuration is paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 8 Gbps. The absence of hyperthreading ensures that each of the 24 vCPUs maps directly to a dedicated physical core, preventing resource contention at the processor level.

The primary tradeoff of the ecs.d1.6xlarge is the use of HDD storage instead of SSDs, which prioritizes raw storage volume and cost-per-gigabyte efficiency over high random IOPS performance. This makes the instance highly cost-effective for sequential read and write operations on massive datasets. It is structurally suited for workloads such as large-scale data warehousing, distributed file systems like HDFS, MapReduce jobs, and cold data archiving.
